source_snapshot: Fresh maintained public tracked+untracked source snapshot; entire analysis/original/install paths, REA databases and previous build outputs absent before compilation.
snapshot_digest_recipe: SHA256 UTF8 json.dumps(files,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon)); each file hash covers exact copied bytes
toolchain: Pinned Nix development shell from copied nix/flake.lock; NASM/Open Watcom DOS8086 small model where applicable.
scope_note: Snapshot taken after current runtime freeze; test/docs metadata may subsequently change. Exact runtime source hashes independently reconciled against workspace manifest.
limitation: Actual isolated source-tree rebuild, not a hermetic filesystem sandbox or complete PCPlus application reconstruction.
scope: Source-only interactive DOS terminal with imported keyboard/action settings, directory UI, recovered line/character editing, maintained current-profile RIS, bounded process handoff, retained far shadow/history and live checked XMODEM receive/send and maintained CRC YMODEM batch ownership; full PCPlus application remains incomplete.

limitations: Interactive terminal milestone, not the complete PCPlus application.

Explicit /X:FILE.XLT stages an exact256-byte input table before UART ownership. Normal terminal bytes translate after connection/raw-monitor/controller/transfer filtering; parser continuations, TX and binary/dedicated owners stay raw. RIS preserves selection. Saved PRM modes0/1/2 select identity, current-directory then bounded PCPLUS-environment PCPLUS.XLT lookup, or a7-bit driver mask; /X overrides valid saved modes. Binary transfers reject non-FF masks. AltF10 mode changes use a frozen pre-child current/PCPLUS namespace, checked table staging and separate confirmation before table/enabled/mask commit while serial ownership is handed off. Explicit /X pins its selection. Queued raw input uses the accepted mode after return. Alt-F9 or Setup/Reload input table stages the frozen active canonical source and asks before accepting a same-mode reload over the drained PROGRAM UART owner, without DOS EXEC. Failed/declined reloads retain the table; queued input uses an accepted table. Startup canonical source paths are limited to63 bytes, including resolved CWD. Alt-F8/menu launches sibling XLTEDIT for the frozen active canonical table via a bounded DOS3+ PSP trailer and direct EXEC. A fresh checked snapshot requires separate confirmation after return. The editor accepts DOS8.3 leaves and absolute63-byte paths with same-parent recovery. Complete resource and settings integration remain unfinished.

Selected ANSI/ordinary controls and ASCII/raw CP437 output; all79 raw keyboard binding slots, function/modifier/keypad banks and bounded binary output now integrated. Specialized controls, fonts, other profiles and full UI remain unfinished.

Maintained /S @8.3-leaf runs local source-built PRMEDIT.EXE directly before UART ownership; failure stops startup and successful return reloads through existing validation/CLI precedence. Alt-F10 invokes the editor through the live PROGRAM handoff for an explicit current-directory8.3 leaf. A canonical startup binding, validated candidate and selective commit adopt display, pacing, future modem commands/responses and BREAK; A separate Y/N choice permits same-port baud/line/flow changes after old-format XON/TEMT handoff; Supported4/6 profile changes use a separate confirmation, staged canonical KBD selection and clean RIS/view baseline. Confirmed COM moves require idle ports, preserve target DTR, restore old hardware/vector ownership and recheck acquisition after profile confirmation. No automatic hangup/redial, original PCSETUP ABI, complete emulation collection or source of defaults.

Standard BIOS-listed COM1..4; explicit partial2.01 PRM import and CLI category overrides. Explicit KBD profile import stages and validates before UART access. AUTO BIOS detection and manual STANDARD/ENHANCED selection supported; no complete PRM schema/default generation.

Explicit-target and directory/browser MODEM/DIRECT connections supported. Native 16-field editor stages changes until acceptance; explicit saves use validated full-file staging and backup replacement.
Successful directory connections queue date/call-count updates for deferred foreground persistence. Replacement does not guarantee crash atomicity or concurrent-writer exclusion.

Stored password remains private metadata, masked in the editor and never automatically transmitted. Scripts, KEY/META bindings and HALF mode fail explicitly; cycles, advanced transfers, Host and the complete original settings/UI remain unfinished.

NETWORK line editing clips counts to the active region and preserves the column. ORIGINAL ANSI CSI M uses a serviced36-tick discard wait; the exact unbounded original helper is not linked. Complex attribute repair remains explicit. Supported-profile RIS restores a captured source-owned startup state and keymap without DOS/file IO.

KBD defaults are maintained network choices, not recovered factory per-profile blocks. Unknown original local actions stop explicitly; Explicit /T:FILE.KEY stages ten actions before UART installation. Alt1..Alt0 execute bounded nonblocking TEXT; PROGRAM uses bounded COMSPEC/PATH lookup, static-parent DOS EXEC, serial handoff, screen restoration and a return key prompt. ASPECT/HOOK execution and binding UI remain unfinished.

Alt-G freezes80x25 characters through recovered row helpers and appends checked PCPLUS.SCR rows via an independent canonical-path file owner. Far memory is retained across PROGRAM. Full original snapshot/printer/script/UI modes remain unfinished.

Alt-F1/F2 processed text capture uses checked append/exclusive creation, pause/resume and periodic buffering. Alt-F3 toggles CR-adds-LF. Write/close failures retain partial logs and sticky exit12; PROGRAM closes capture before EXEC. Full capture/printer/settings/UI and ASPECT modes remain unfinished.

Ctrl-backslash enters a serviced raw monitor using the actual UART and renderer. Explicit Y replaces PCPLUS.DMP through a third checked canonical-path owner; other answers select view-only. Binary256-byte buffering, periodic flush and failure-aware shutdown preserve text-capture ownership. Nested local/KEY/PROGRAM owners are blocked; the exact original owner/resolver/prompt remain separate diagnostics. Native HOOK and complete monitor/UI geometry remain unfinished.

AltR receives ordinary XMODEM CRC/checksum128/1024 using the real UART and checked staged DOS storage. HARD/NONE only; SOFT rejects before staging. FinalACK follows checked installation. AltS uses the native ordinary sender with checked read-only DOS source files and automatic1K blocks; only actual ACKs advance maintained progress. F2 inside the transfer prompt selects maintained CRC YMODEM batch transfer with checked per-file ownership and exact declared lengths. Window/streaming/other protocols, full transfer settings/UI and physical peers remain unfinished.

CtrlPgUp opens a maintained63000-byte frozen history viewer in80x25 BIOS mode3/page0 with local line/page/Home/End navigation, ASCII case-insensitive incremental search/F3 and Escape return to the updated live screen. UART/parser/history/capture/replies continue, with frame swaps at top-level receive/idle and64 search candidates per turn. W appends the frozen snapshot through a fourth checked file owner, expanding CR to CRLF in128-source-byte foreground chunks. Append/create, short writes, cancellation, close ambiguity and DOS child inheritance are checked. Alt-= opens a maintained filename clipboard and C enters it from redisplay. The15-entry list supports bounded extraction, add/edit/delete/purge, tags, runtime decimal separator and one/all/tagged paste. Whole-packet TX admission requires an empty queue; cancellation removes only the unsent prefix and preserves later parser replies. Single removal waits for actual UART acceptance, and connection queue resets retain the entry as interrupted. PRM04EA imports a validated0..255 separator through the44-byte settings plan; PRMEDIT offers46 fields. Live setup applies deliberate saved separator edits and preserves session R across canceled/no-op/unrelated returns using an acknowledged source baseline in the628-byte candidate owner. Full native UI, transfer-prompt workflows and other geometries remain unfinished.

PROGRAM preserves DTR, pauses configured flow and releases its UART IRQ during child execution; NONE cannot guarantee incoming-data preservation while a child owns the machine. No physical UART/modem/public BBS validation. ENiGMA editor escape-fragmentation behavior remains a server/packetization compatibility boundary.

Alt-Z opens a source-owned five-group command menu, contextual help and bounded ASCII help search. Existing commands run only after the shared redisplay owner restores the live screen; history/clipboard re-enter their usual guards. Incoming UART/parser/history/replies continue while browsing. Menu code and read-only text reside in CONFIG_CODE, with only bounded state/query bytes near. Original pull-down layout, advertised mouse paths, full settings/key editing and other video geometries remain unfinished.

An otherwise eligible Alt-Z read during normal parser ownership is retained until a distinct resident foreground service can recheck all guards. All BIOS key values, including AX0, retain their key meaning. Subsequent keys remain in the existing32-word typeahead FIFO; repeated Alt-Z coalesces. Escape cancels locally; Alt-X/Alt-H cancel then use normal dispatch. Changed owners/geometry or foreground stop discard the owned pending typeahead. Overflow retains the existing explicit exit3 policy. This is maintained behavior; it does not identify the cause of the earlier unobserved Synchronet refusal.

Maintained YMODEM framing and header codec execute in CONFIG_CODE with unchanged near data and protocol logic. Explicit callbacks bridge resident UART/CRC/file owners; zero-argument callbacks have their own declared family. Newly compiled batch_header OMF imports for Watcom32-bit arithmetic are renamed to local register adapters; all code/data/fixup records and external indices are preserved. Original ordinary XMODEM modules remain resident and unchanged.

compiler_helper_adapters.record_policy: Only EXTDEF names/record lengths/checksums change; symbol indices, code, data, local symbols and fixups are preserved.
